You can customize the confirmation, cancellation and reminder emails from your Booking Settings:

1. Go to **Booking Settings** in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Emails & SMS notifications**.
3. Hover over the email you want to change and click **Edit**.
4. (Reminders only) Click **Edit** next to **Timing** to change when it's sent.
5. Under **Action 1**, choose what to change:
   - **Manage details:** sender's name and reply-to email.
   - **Create an email:** click **Edit** to change the text and existing elements, or add images, videos and more. You can also **Switch Template** (this replaces your current email and its changes).
6. Click **Save**.

Note: only certain parts of the pre-installed emails can be edited, so key session details always reach clients. The main image is the one you chose for the service.

For a **Wix Video** player:

1. In your editor, click the Wix Video player.
2. Click **Settings**, then the **Player** tab.
3. Turn on the **Autoplay on load** toggle.

Things to know:
- Autoplaying videos always start **muted** because of browser restrictions.
- The toggle isn't available for the **strip** and **slider** layouts.
- For your **mobile site**, click the video in the mobile editor, click the **Settings** icon and use the **Autoplays** toggle. Some mobile devices may still block autoplay (e.g. in low-power mode).

response:
Once a payout shows as **sent**, it usually takes **3-5 business days** to reach your bank account. The exact arrival date depends on things like the day of the week, the currency and bank holidays. So at 4 calendar days, the payout may still be within the normal window, especially if a weekend or holiday fell in between.

What you can do now:
- Go to **Payouts** in your site's dashboard and click the payout to check its details and amount.
- If you have several payment methods, your payouts may be grouped, so you may see more than one payout for the same date.

If it still hasn't arrived after 5 business days, I can connect you with a support agent to look into it.

The image shown when sharing your link is your **og:image**. You can set it per page or for the whole site, and you must **publish** afterwards for the change to take effect.

**For one page:**
1. In the editor, click **Pages & Menu**.
2. Click the page, then **More Actions** → **Social share**.
3. Click **Upload Image**, choose an image, and click **Add to Page**.
4. **Publish** your site.

**For the whole site:**
1. Open your site's settings → **Website settings**.
2. Under **General social image**, click **Upload Image** and choose an image.
3. Click **Save**, then **Publish**.

Tips: use an aspect ratio of **1.91:1** (width about 1.9× the height) to avoid cropping. If a page has its own og:image, it overrides the site-wide one.

You can copy the page from the copy site and paste it into the original, as long as both are Wix Editor sites:

1. In the **copy** site's editor, click **Menus & Pages**.
2. Right-click the edited page and click **Copy**.
3. Open the **original** site's editor (in the same browser).
4. Right-click anywhere and select **Paste** (or **Paste & Apply Site Theme** to use the original site's colors and fonts).
5. Rename the new page if needed and click **Done**.

Keep in mind:
- The pasted page is added as a **new main page**, so you may want to delete the old version.
- Only regular pages can be copied. Pages from apps like Wix Stores or Bookings, and elements such as Velo code, headers/footers, datasets and Wix Pro Gallery, don't copy.
- If pasting doesn't work, your browser's local storage may be full. Clearing it usually helps.

To add a subscribe form:

1. Go to your editor.
2. Click **Add Elements** on the left.
3. Click **Contact & Forms**.
4. Scroll to the **Subscribe** section and drag a form onto your page.
5. Click **Settings** (or **Form Settings**) to customize it, for example:
   - Layout and design (background, fields, buttons)
   - Email notifications for new submissions
   - Double opt-in, so subscribers confirm their email
   - What happens after submitting (success message or redirect)

People who submit the form are automatically added to your contacts with a **Subscriber** label.

To delete a lightbox:

1. In the editor, click **Pages & Menu** on the left.
2. Click **Lightboxes** and find the subscription lightbox.
3. Click its **More Actions** icon.
4. Click **Delete**.
5. **Publish** your site so the change goes live.

If you can't find it, open the **Lightboxes** list in Pages & Menu. Lightbox names don't show on your live site, so it may be called something like "Subscribe" or "Sign Up Form".

You can edit the text of your Wix Bookings automated emails from Booking Settings:

1. Go to **Booking Settings** in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Emails & SMS notifications**.
3. Hover over the confirmation, cancellation or reminder email and click **Edit**.
4. Under **Action 1 → Create an email**, click **Edit** to change the existing text and elements, or add new ones.
5. To personalize the text, click **+ Add Dynamic Value**, pick a value (e.g. the client's name) and add fallback text such as "valued client".
6. Click **Save & Continue**. (Optional) Use **Preview & test** to send yourself a test email.
7. Click **Save**.

Note: only certain parts of these pre-installed emails can be edited, so important booking details always get through.

response:
You can refund a Wix Payments payment from the **Payments** page:

**Desktop:**
1. Go to **Payments** in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the payment you want to refund.
3. Click **Refund**, enter the amount (and a note if needed), and click **Refund**.

**Wix app:** go to **Payments**, tap the payment, tap **Refund**, enter the amount and tap **Issue Refund**.

If you can't see Payments in the menu, try **Catalog → Payments & Finance → All Payments**.

Good to know: refunds take 3-5 business days to reach the customer and can't be canceled once issued. If your Wix Payments balance can't cover the refund, you'll be asked to add funds.

response:
Here's how to get your site indexed:

**1. Allow search engines to index your site**
1. Go to your **SEO** dashboard.
2. Select **Go to SEO Settings** under Tools and settings.
3. Make sure **Let search engines index your site** is turned on.

**2. Publish your site.** Search engines can only index published pages and changes.

**3. Submit your sitemap.** The easiest way is the **Wix SEO Setup Checklist**: when you complete it, Wix connects your site to Google Search Console and submits your sitemap for you automatically. You don't need to resubmit after changes, as the sitemap updates itself.

Note: connecting to Google Search Console requires a **Premium plan and a connected domain**. Indexing can also take some time after submission.
